changes: Only native GNU Linux cases use the GNU compiler profile; Clang covers every supported target.
Native feature-query tests honor TOUCAN_GCC and calibrate only their mock fallthrough value once per compiler.
Deterministic unit cases preserve1,201910,202311 under both query dialects.
Malformed arguments, acceptance, output comparisons and compiler-crash detection remain enforced.
